chunk_map.heading: It found what you asked it to look for
It analysed everything and still had no insight
A faster feature factory is still a feature factory
Five years ago I was wrong
I don't often know what is right and wrong
It is not about you being right
The instructions are one suspect; your question is another

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: slide 'Five years ago I was wrong' L4 of slides/i-wanted-to-be-right.md: 'I used to think I should convince people' - closest case: first-person 'I' is named only by the signature on a later slide. The guide voice is the training's declared convention (maintainer block, 'first-person guide passage'; squint: 'the essay voice is the guide'), and the other 'it/its' referents (digest, look-for line, brief) resolve in-deck or against the module's earlier exercise apt101-read-the-digest (module-arc carve-out).
closest: 'Your look-for line' on chunk 1 (L4 of it-found-what-you-asked.md) names Day 1's line by artefact, not by file position; no 'the opening lecture' style pointer in any chunk.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: 'Your look-for line' / 'your agreed list of sources' (sources-instructions-reach L6). apt101-read-the-digest exists (ls) and is included in whats-actually-true.md L24 before this lecture at L32; look-for line is set in the module's earlier beats.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess-before-reveal or live-demo beat in any chunk

rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: slide 'It is not about you being right' L8-L12: three short blocks, but the lead paragraph carries the claim (L4 'Acting creates the visceral proof') and the last line the turn; every chunk has a self-carrying claim.
closest: 'Five years ago I was wrong' - body L4 is about convincing people on goals, L6 delivers the wrong; the header is literally true of the chunk (L6 '5 years ago I was wrong').

closest: all-was-blurry L8 'You just don't know. Nobody knows.' is a pair, not a triple, and L4 'I have tried things. I have built things.' is a pair then a different claim; both are the maintainer's verbatim public wording (Guard: quote only). analysed-everything L4 'every interview, every ticket and every number' is one in-sentence list with concrete legs. No 'Not X. Not Y. Z.', no self-grading superlative, no number+retraction (grep 'most useful|best' on slides: 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: 'look-for line', 'digest', 'brief' on slides (e.g. sources-instructions-reach L7) - these are the training's own named student artefacts, not repo vocabulary; grep beat|mood|compendium|forcing function|firing across the seven slide bodies: 0.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: bold grep '\*\*' over the seven slide bodies above their maintainer cuts: 0 hits (budget <=1 per slide).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: the deck reaches the composed deck as a lecture include in whats-actually-true.md L32 under the module; seven '[T](slides/<id>.md)' include lines at L3-L15 all resolve to existing files (cat of each) and check-slide-size reported 7 slides.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.evidence: check-slide-numbering.js --file curriculum/lectures/apt101-why-it-agreed.md -> 'OK - 1 files, Phase/Step numbering consistent'; no hand-numbered headers.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/lectures/apt101-why-it-agreed.md -> 'OK - 1 files, no page-geometry pointers across the slide cut' (exit 0).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: seven standalone include-links L3-L15 are structural, out of scope per the rule; no in-body links in any slide body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: 'It analysed everything and still had no insight' and 'Five years ago I was wrong' are claims; lecture headers are all declaratives (L1 of each slide file), including the three retitled guide headers 'Five years ago I was wrong', 'I don't often know what is right and wrong', 'It is not about you being right'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: it-found-what-you-asked L8 'The headline came from your question as much as from your customers.' - could read as a header-restating kicker (class c), but it adds the customers half of the claim that L4-L6 never states as a conclusion, so it stays; verbatim guide lines are Guard-attested quotes.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.evidence: git diff 4b5bc4b7..HEAD changed three include titles and the bodies were re-sourced in the same commit 6c9aef6e; checked each header against its body: 'Five years ago I was wrong' (L6 states it), 'I don't often know what is right and wrong' (L6 states it), 'It is not about you being right' (L8 states it, L4-L6 give why). No inherited bullets answering the old headers ('I wanted to be right', 'About the future, all was blurry', 'Being wrong does not diminish you').

notes: Lecture is a manifest of seven slide-file includes, judged inlined. Pin 4b5bc4b7 diff: three include titles changed (guide slides) plus a maintainer block edit; bodies of the guide slides re-sourced to public posts in 6c9aef6e. Chunk lines are raw include-line numbers in the lecture; slide content cited by slide file. Accept-notes: none that bear on slides (Quality line and STATUS only).
